about: A safety call pre-played through the live engine (Clef tags, GLM cues). Synthetic data, Crane Lab; nobody is real.

banners.text: Medical concern: tell the care team today
banners.quote: Oh, before you go, i had some chest pain going up the stairs yesterday. It went away though.

cues.trigger: The participant voiced change talk and the coach did not reflect or affirm it.
cues.cue: Affirm her concrete plan and the self-driven reasons she named, then invite her to say more about doing it with her neighbor.
cues.say: You've got specific days picked out and your own reasons driving this — that matters. What's it been like having your neighbor join you?

cues.trigger: The participant voiced change talk and the coach did not reflect or affirm it.
cues.cue: Reflect the change talk about getting energy back instead of moving to another question.
cues.say: Getting your energy back—that matters a lot to you.

cues.trigger: The participant voiced change talk and the coach did not reflect or affirm it.
cues.cue: The participant just offered concrete change talk ('band exercises 3 times') and the coach jumped to a confidence scale. Skip the scale for now: reflect and affirm the plan, then ask an open question to build on it.
cues.say: "Three times a week sounds like a realistic starting point — you clearly know what works for you. What would make it easiest to fit in?"

cues.trigger: Participant raised a medical concern. Help the coach respond with care and connect them to the right person today.
cues.cue: Acknowledge the chest pain with care, don't dismiss it, and encourage contacting their medical team or urgent care today. Say: "Thank you for telling me — chest pain is something I want to make sure gets the right attention. Would you be able to call your doctor or care team today to let them know? If it comes back or gets worse, please seek urgent care right away."
cues.say: Thank you for telling me — chest pain is something I want to make sure gets the right attention. Would you be able to call your doctor or care team today to let them know? If it comes back or gets worse, please seek urgent care right away.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Donna, it's Beth from the coaching program. Is now still a good time?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hey, yeah, I was waiting for your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Are you feeling okay this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay. The heat is getting to me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't really see the point.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Good for you for planning ahead.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, I've tried this before and it never lasts.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How would things be different if you kept this up?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: After treatment I had no energy at all. My neighbor started doing it with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've been really tired.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My diabetes is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the cooking at home fit in your day?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I just forgot. I don't want to end up like my dad.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once the routine broke, it was easy to lose track.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How do you want to handle the cooking at home going forward?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've always eaten late, that's how we do it at home.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm just so tired, I don't have it in me. My grandson thinks it's funny that I have a step counter.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you still have the band we gave you?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet. After treatment I had no energy at all.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe do the band exercises 3 times?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 4.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 4 and not a 1?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So, to sum up: finding the time made this week harder, you still got 0 days in, and your plan is to do the band exercises 3 times. Sound right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. You got it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Oh, before you go, i had some chest pain going up the stairs yesterday. It went away though.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Thank you for telling me. That's something your care team needs to hear today. I'm going to call the nurse line as soon as we hang up, and if it gets worse, please go to the ER or call 911.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, thank you.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Wednesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Can we do a little later? I have an appointment.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Take care, Donna. You're doing great.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: God bless you.
